entries.title: Job 14:1
segments: Man, that is born of a woman, Is of few days, and full of trouble.

entries.title: Job 14:2
segments: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

entries.title: Job 14:3
segments: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such a one, And bringest me into judgment with thee?

entries.title: Job 14:4
segments: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

entries.title: Job 14:5
segments: Seeing his days are determined, The number of his months is with thee, And thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

entries.title: Job 14:6
segments: Look away from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

entries.title: Job 14:7
segments: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

entries.title: Job 14:8
segments: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;

entries.title: Job 14:9
segments: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, And put forth boughs like a plant.

entries.title: Job 14:10
segments: But man dieth, and is laid low: Yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

entries.title: Job 14:11
segments: [As] the waters fail from the sea, And the river wasteth and drieth up;

entries.title: Job 14:12
segments: So man lieth down and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be roused out of their sleep.

entries.title: Job 14:13
segments: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in Sheol, That thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, That thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

entries.title: Job 14:14
segments: If a man die, shall he live [again]? All the days of my warfare would I wait, Till my release should come.

entries.title: Job 14:15
segments: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer thee: Thou wouldest have a desire to the work of thy hands.

entries.title: Job 14:16
segments: But now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?

entries.title: Job 14:17
segments: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou fastenest up mine iniquity.

entries.title: Job 14:18
segments: But the mountain falling cometh to nought; And the rock is removed out of its place;

entries.title: Job 14:19
segments: The waters wear the stones; The overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth: So thou destroyest the hope of man.

entries.title: Job 14:20
segments: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth; Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

entries.title: Job 14:21
segments: His sons come to honor, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

entries.title: Job 14:22
segments: But his flesh upon him hath pain, And his soul within him mourneth.
